verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents natural-language querying through Amplitude AI, and its MCP server brings its data into AI tools such as Claude and Cursor for conversational answers. The evidence covers asking questions and getting answers, not issuing natural-language commands that operate the product, such as creating charts, cohorts, flags or experiments. Missing for 10: documented natural-language actions or commands beyond Q&A, details of what the MCP server can change, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask questions in plain language — Amplitude AI surfaces answers across all your data.
Start a conversation about your users or product and get expert-level answers in seconds that you can share with your whole org. No SQL, configuring dashboards, or waiting on the data team.
Bring Amplitude’s behavioral context directly into your AI tools—Claude, Cursor, OpenAI, Lovable, Figma, and more—to get answers where you work.
